milestones.title: Wipe-clean
milestones.body: Something came back on you, and it did not stick, and a colleague says you are very easy to work with, not meaning it kindly. You have earned a Milestone: Wipe-clean.

milestones.title: Slippery as an eel
milestones.body: Another one slid off. People have started to check the minutes after meetings you were in, to see what you said, and you never said anything. You have earned a Milestone: Slippery as an eel.

milestones.title: Non-stick, dishwasher safe
milestones.body: Nothing that comes back on you has ever stayed, and somebody in Finance has started a sweepstake on it. You have earned a Milestone: Non-stick, dishwasher safe.

milestones.title: Team player
milestones.body: Some sucking up paid off, and somebody upstairs said your name. A colleague says you are a real team player, and looks at your boss while saying it. You have earned a Milestone: Team player.

milestones.title: Professional nodder
milestones.body: You agreed with something before it had finished being said, and your neck has started to ache at about the time of the Monthly Alignment Meeting. You have earned a Milestone: Professional nodder.

milestones.title: Human footstool
milestones.body: Your boss rests a cup of coffee on you without noticing, and you thank them for the opportunity. The Office Co-ordinator has added you to the inventory, under furniture. You have earned a Milestone: Human footstool.
